content: चण्डाल {%a.%} [चण्ड्-आलच्] .²1 Wicked or cruel in deeds; of black deeds (क्रूरकर्मन्); <ab>cf.</ab> कर्मचाण्डाल. .{@-लः@} A general name for the lowest and most despised of the mixed castes originating from a Śūdra father and a Brāhmaṇa mother. .²2 A man of this caste, an outcast; चण्डालः किमयं द्विजातिरथवा <ls>Bh. 3. 56</ls>; <ls>Ms. 5. 131</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">10. 12</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 10.">16</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">11. 176</ls>.
